$Comment: The Hallowed: the name, picture and payouts of the game's reputation group of the same id
(NPC/Reputation/Groups/Hallows_Eve_Hallowed.json), a reputation with no characters in it. Players
read the name from reputation.hallows_eve_hallowed.name; never rename the id, since every
player's favor is filed under it.
Kills pays Amount favor for each creature put down whose role is in one of the listed NPC
groups; Hallows_Eve_Event_Mobs (NPC/Groups) holds the season's four night creatures and the
Horseman's Jack Archers. The Undead row counts the game's own Undead group (its skeletons and
zombies, and any other mod's undead that joins it) only while its Season,
Seasons_Of_Orbis_Restless_Moon, is live: a full moon outside Hallow's Eve, so during Hallow's
Eve only the season's creatures pay.
The Jack
Shield, the Flaming Jack Shield and the Hallowed set raise every gain of this favor by a percent
while worn, through the stat ReputationGain_Hallows_Eve_Hallowed (Entity/Stats), which the library
finds by this file's id. With no Cap, favor keeps climbing past Exalted, and each time earned favor passes another multiple of Every above
Exalted's floor, Beyond's Rewards wait for the player to collect them on the Reputation page: here
the loot table Hallows_Eve_Hallowed_Cache. Its ranks open offers at Old Jack's stall: Friendly the
Spyglass and the Goblin Repair Kits, Honored the Scrap Glider, Revered the Burning Jack Helm and
Exalted the Flaming Jack Shield. The Horseman's Hoard on the hard ride pays this favor for the first
hard win each day (Lootables/HallowsEvePack/Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Chase_Hard.json), and every clear
of his graveyard pays it on either ride (Lootables/HallowsEvePack/Hallows_Eve_Graveyard_Clear.json
and _Clear_Hard.json).
Earn lists the ways to earn favor, one lang key a line, for the How to earn block on the
Reputation page.
